verdict.rationale: Lever documents a public developer API with OAuth, application endpoints (list, create, list deleted), audit-event listing and webhooks, so programmatic access exists. Nothing shows the API matches the UI, and many UI features have no API evidence: career site builder, analytics dashboards, Automation Hub, nurture campaigns and the AI form builder. Missing for 10: any documented claim of API/UI parity; API coverage for career sites, dashboards/reporting, automation rules, nurture, onboarding and AI features; independent or hands-on corroboration of API breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
